facts.fact: A peer-reviewed article says Mali has no single access to information law yet: the legal framework for the right is spread across several laws, among them Law no. 98-012 on relations between the administration and its users, and the article calls for a specific law; it names no draft and gives no date for this, so the document's publication date (2026-04-01) is used.
facts.system: Loi n°98-012 relative aux relations entre l'administration et les usagers (1998)
